method.interior: Piecewise linear interpolation of observed USD/m against true reference outside diameter. This is an estimator, not a supplier quotation for an interpolated size.
method.exterior: Outside observed size range, scale the nearest endpoint USD/m by authored dimension / endpoint dimension. Constant wall/gauge proportional material assumption; manufacturing/end costs and specification changes not modeled.
method.rectangular: Scale complete12x8 duct USD/m by authored section perimeter /1.016m. Constant gauge/connection cost-per-perimeter proxy.
method.ladder: Scale24in ladder USD/m by authored width /0.6096m. Simplified material-width proxy ignores fixed rail costs and load class.
method.low_central_high: 0.5x,1x,1.5x the calculated reference-based rate. Analyst-declared sensitivity factors; neither confidence limits nor observed quote range.
method.unknown_pipe_material: Non-PVC pipe groups use steel as an explicitly assumed material cost proxy. Standard labels do not establish steel; no material change is proposed.
method.grooved_or_welded: 6.4008m stock costs use21ft threaded/coupled blacksteel public prices as a length/material proxy. Groove/weld preparation and specification equivalence not included.
method.unavailable_reference: 2in21ft reference is out of stock; including it estimates money only, does not assert an executable purchase order.

fabrication_assumptions: Offcuts can be recut and their required ends recreated under unchanged service specification. This must be confirmed before procurement.
Per-group pooling requires identical material, wall/gauge and end specification; source missing properties are assumptions, not verified equivalence.
Any model span split into stock-size pieces uses fixed assumed joint locations in every compared scenario; extra joints have no modeled installation approval or net saving.
Rigid stock policies exclude flex ducts. No savings assigned to fire alarm devices or unknown wire routes.
